name: uml_review_bundle
description: Build the UML review context bundle, how-it-works guides, and the navigable static review website in one pass.

inputs.context_output_dir: Optional output directory for the context bundle. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_context.
inputs.site_output_dir: Optional output directory for the review site. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_site.
inputs.site_title: Optional website title. Defaults to UML Review Explorer.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.neighbor_depth: How far module neighborhoods should be expanded for context. Defaults to 1.
inputs.max_neighbors: Maximum neighbor modules retained per module. Defaults to 10.
inputs.guide_output_dir: Optional output directory for the generated how-it-works guide bundle. Defaults to Docs/uml/how_it_works.
inputs.include_guides: Whether guide pages should be generated and embedded into the site. Defaults to true.

outputs.context: Paths for the generated UML review context bundle.
outputs.site: Paths for the generated UML review website.
outputs.guides: Paths for the generated how-it-works guide bundle.
